d: Anant Singh Daughters Wedding: ek taraph beti ki shadi men pita apne hone vale damad ko karoron ki lagjari kar gipht karne ki taiyari men hain.... to dusri taraph hone vale sasur bhi apni bahu ke svagat men koee kasar nahin chhorna chahte.... bahu ke lie char manjila aalishan makan taiyar karvaya ja raha hai.... rishtedaron ki taraph se 100 khassi lane ki bat ho rahi hai..... jiski taiyariyan abhi se surkhiyan bator rahi hain.... lekin saval ye hai ki aakhir shivangi ke hone vale sasur ne unke svagat ke lie kya-kya khas intjam kie hain.... shadi ke bad unki jindgi kis tarah badalne vali…
